questions.question: Explain how each of the 4 R’s—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, and Recover / —contribute to sustainability.
questions.solution_html:
• The 4 Rs - Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, and Recover - are key strategies for sustainability.
  • - Reduce: Minimizes waste generation and resource consumption, decreasing the environmental footprint.
  • - Reuse: Extends product lifespan, reducing the need for new raw materials and waste generation.
  • - Recycle: Transforms waste into new products, conserving resources and reducing landfill waste.
  • - Recover: Involves recovering materials or energy from waste, reducing landfill disposal and extracting
  • value from discarded materials.
  • Together, the 4 Rs help conserve resources, reduce pollution, and promote a circular economy
  • significantly contributing to sustainability.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How do nanotech and enzyme-based processing aid sustainable textiles?
questions.solution_html:
• Nanotechnology and plasma-based processing contribute to sustainable textile production by
  • - Reducing chemical usage and water consumption
  • - Enhancing fabric properties like durability, stain resistance, and UV protection
  • - Enabling efficient dyeing and finishing processes
  • - Minimizing waste generation
  • These technologies offer eco-friendly alternatives to traditional methods, decreasing environmental
  • impact while improving textile performance.

questions.question: Discuss the future of eco-friendly fashion, highlighting key trends, / impacts, and challenges that shape its role in the fashion industry.
questions.solution_html:
• shapes its role in the fashion industry.
  • A. The future of eco-friendly fashion is bright, with sustainability becoming a central theme in the fashion
  • industry. Key trends shaping its role include
  • - Circular Fashion: Designing clothes for reuse, recycling, and biodegradability, reducing waste and
  • environmental footprint. Brands like Patagonia and Eileen Fisher are implementing take-back programs
  • and repair services.
  • - Eco-Friendly Materials: Organic cotton, recycled polyester, hemp, and innovative materials like
  • mycelium leather and Pinatex are gaining popularity.
  • - Slow Fashion: Emphasizing quality over quantity, encouraging consumers to invest in timeless pieces.
  • - Digital Fashion: Virtual try-ons, digital clothing, and AI-powered design tools reducing waste and
  • environmental impact.
  • The impact of eco-friendly fashion is significant
  • - Environmental Benefits: Reduced carbon emissions, water consumption, and waste generation.
  • - Social Benefits: Fair labor practices, safe working conditions, and transparent supply chains.
  • However, challenges remain
  • - Scaling Sustainable Practices: Meeting mass production demands while maintaining eco-friendly
  • standards.
  • - Consumer Awareness: Educating consumers about sustainable fashion and its benefits.
  • - Higher Costs: Sustainable materials and practices often increase prices, making eco-friendly fashion
  • less accessible.
  • To overcome these challenges, collaboration between brands, governments, and consumers is crucial.
  • Social media and influencers are playing a key role in promoting sustainable fashion awareness.
  • B. As consumers increasingly demand eco-friendly options, the fashion industry is expected to shift towards
  • sustainability, making it the norm rather than the exception.
  • Prepared by
  • Ms. Nimisha Devasia
  • Asst. Professor
  • YMBC, KOTHAMANGALAM
questions.final_answer: Option The future of eco-friendly fashion is bright, with sustainability becoming a central theme in the fashion

  • - Enhancing fabric properties like durability, stain resistance, and UV protection
  • - Enabling efficient dyeing and finishing processes
  • - Minimizing waste generation
  • These technologies offer eco-friendly alternatives to traditional methods, decreasing environmental
  • impact while improving textile performance.

questions.question: Discuss the future of eco-friendly fashion, highlighting key trends, / impacts, and challenges that shape its role in the fashion industry.

  • environmental footprint. Brands like Patagonia and Eileen Fisher are implementing take-back programs
  • and repair services.
  • - Eco-Friendly Materials: Organic cotton, recycled polyester, hemp, and innovative materials like
